designs.artworkPrompt: Give me an image with Katie in watercolor style with a standard finish and no effect. Katie is a stone-sculpted figure from urban legend with a quiet, observant personality, standing within a hand-drawn circle. Use a background visually related to myth and folklore with sketch-style old town buildings and soft watercolor washes. No borders, no frames. Katie should be horizontally and vertically centered. The subject should fill around 2/4 of the total image size. The image must use a 1:1 aspect ratio in webp format and named MYT-KAT-GEN001-0001.webp.
designs.loreDescription: A collectible Katie Arcori generation I from the Myth Genesis Series. A figure whispered about in old towns, said to appear wherever stories outlive the people who tell them.
